So promissory added after devaluation — promissory is protected from devaluation! sell_credit gives revenue*1.25 as promissory. So sell_credit is strongly better than sell for cash held across rounds, especially: sell gives cash now, which will be devalued at start of next round (×0.62 if cash in "soft" units? floor(cash/100)*62 means 62% retained). Promissory avoids devaluation and gives 25% bonus. So selling via sell_credit is massively better. Let's verify with data: compute per-game cash trajectories.

So promissory from round 5 market gets added at start of round 6 without devaluation. Then round 6 market sell... final cash counted directly. So sell_credit is good until round 6 market, where sell_credit yields nothing (promissory unpaid after last round).
